subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should existing WhatsApp LID-form allowlist entries become fail-closed after upgrade unless Doctor can prove a single account-scoped LID-to-PN mapping and migrate them to E.164?
rationale: This is an intentional authorization and upgrade-policy choice: the implementation can preserve no same-digit inference and warn operators, but only maintainers can decide whether that compatibility break is the desired security contract.

options.title: Accept scoped fail-closed migration
options.body: Keep the proposed Doctor migration and warnings, allowing only verified account-scoped mappings to convert legacy LID entries to canonical E.164 values.

options.title: Preserve legacy authorization temporarily
options.body: Retain LID-form allowlist behavior until a separately approved deprecation and migration plan is defined, accepting a longer-lived ambiguous authorization surface.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed Doctor migration and warnings, allowing only verified account-scoped mappings to convert legacy LID entries to canonical E.164 values.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-member author of the supplied JID and migration series and are best positioned to clarify the intended WhatsApp behavior before a final maintainer decision.
